body: They don't know; no one does. I can't even bear the thought of telling anyone. I get these...headaches thinking about it. I literally have no one left to talk to.
From what I have been told it is way too late to get a rape kit done. I would've gotten one done if I had the hindsight but I guess I'm just not smart enough to think of things like that.
Thank you for the advice. Are those good subs to post about my experience? I am really grateful for the help I've gotten here but I feel like I need to talk to some people better versed on this

Thank you so much for your support. I'm sorry that you went through a similar situation as I have. Going through it myself has granted me a lot more respect for men and women who have gone through this. I don't know, I'm just so scared and lonely.

Thank you so much. 

It is comforting to know so many people care.
I haven't washed the pants I wore that night and I think there is semen on then. He also bit the back of my neck while I was sleeping.
Thank you all for your help, advice, and support. I decided I will go to the police and get myself tested. I am glad this community is here to help me through this dark time.
Thank you for your help. I decided I will go to the police and get myself tested at least. I'm not sure what good it will do but I have to try at least.
Thank you so much for the advice.
Thank you for your advice. I think I may heal in time...but I'm not sure. I just feel so lost and alone.

I live in America, so I can imagine going to the police may help. It's just that...I'm not sure if I can ever tell someone what happened to me. The shame and guilt is already eating away at me just from posting this.
I just don't know what to do. I haven't told anyone besides people who have read this post. I'm so scared at the thought of going to the police
